files.positive_when_one.fsm:
(?fsm:positive_when_one

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input request)
    (input allow)
    (input datain)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (request 1)
    (allow 1)
    (datain 3)
    (seen 3)
    (done 1)
    (can_accept 1)
    (tick_start 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (captured datain))
    (< (!= 1 0)
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (seen> captured))
    (-> main_done_2)
  )

  (main_done_2
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

  (-tick
    (<- (seen> datain) <tick_start)
  )

)
